name: io.github.frankxai/starlight-skill-index
description: Semantic router over a large SKILL.md library. search_skills returns the best-matching skills for a task so an agent loads one skill body instead of scanning the whole catalog — cutting skill-routing token cost. Also exposes get_skill, list_packs, and a frontmatter security_report. Degrades gracefully to a stdlib catalog fallback when the pgvector store isn't built.

environmentVariables.name: STARLIGHT_CATALOG
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to catalog.json (the skill index). If unset, the server auto-discovers ../index/catalog.json or ./catalog.json.

environmentVariables.name: STARLIGHT_INDEX_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory containing search.py and scan_skill_frontmatter.py. Auto-discovered next to the server if unset.

environmentVariables.name: STARLIGHT_DB_URL
environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL+pgvector connection URL. Its presence enables the semantic vector path; without it the server uses the stdlib catalog fallback. Secret — provide via your MCP client's secret store, never commit it.

environmentVariables.name: STARLIGHT_SCAN_REPORT
environmentVariables.description: Path to a cached scan_report.json from scan_skill_frontmatter.py. If unset, security_report runs the scan live over the catalog.

environmentVariables.name: STARLIGHT_SECURITY_ALLOWLIST
environmentVariables.description: Path to exact content-addressed scan exceptions. If unset, the server uses security-allowlist.json beside the active catalog.

environmentVariables.name: STARLIGHT_SKILLS_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Base directory used to resolve a skill's relative path to its on-disk body when body_path is absent.

provenance.note: Namespace io.github.frankxai is verified by authenticating with the GitHub account 'frankxai' via `mcp-publisher login github`. The repository above lives under the same GitHub owner, which the registry checks against the verified namespace.
